blocks.text: DAVAO CITY — The Ateneo de Davao University (AdDU) on Thursday said it had dismissed the student who allegedly bullied another following a thorough investigation. In a statement posted on its social media account, the university said it had “completed the disciplinary proceedings concerning the student found responsible for the bullying incident in our Junior High School.” “Following due process, the student has been dismissed from the Junior High School, effective immediately. Our inquiry into other aspects of the incident, including the involvement of other students, continues,” the university said.
